title: chore(scripts): keep the spec-major fingerprint in its gate, not the v17 sweep ledger
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9HiJAYedonvaHNCDwdoW14J)_
Part of #26075
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

PR 1 of 2 under ruling A (6417413905). It moves the detection fingerprint that `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` kept in `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md` into the script, so PR 2 can delete the ledger without touching the gate. #26075 stays open for PR 2, which deletes the eight obsolete planning docs and makes the other root-doc changes.

## What changed (one file: `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs`)

- **The fingerprint row now lives in the script.** The ledger's `@objectstack/spec 18` fingerprint row is copied verbatim into a new constant, `SWEEP_FINGERPRINT`. Its provenance is `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md` as of `df8aac41`. The two header passages that pointed readers at the ledger now point at that constant.
- **The self-test reads the fingerprint from its new home.** The R1 "double-backtick pattern span → GREEN" row now uses `SWEEP_FINGERPRINT` itself. One new battery is its negative control: `R1 — the relocated fingerprint with its double backticks reduced to single → RED`. It runs the same row with only the delimiters changed. If that replacement ever stops matching, the row stays a pattern span and reads GREEN, so the control also proves the fixture still carries the citation. `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` goes from 33 to 34.
- **The ledger's `QUOTATION_EXEMPTIONS` entry is removed.** It excused the sweep log line ``**Fingerprint added:** the `@objectstack/spec` 18 row above``. That entry pinned major 18, and `main` already publishes `packages/spec` 18.1.0, so it was DORMANT and excused nothing. The gate's pass line already asked for it to be deleted ("delete once `main` itself carries that major").
- **Self-test rows look up ledger entries by file, not by index**, through a new `ledgerEntry(file)` helper. Removing that entry therefore cannot silently point a row at the entry next to it. Fixture paths that named the ledger file now use `docs/fingerprints.md`. The DORMANT row keeps its ADR-0087 sentence and drops the ledger's.

The gate's behaviour is unchanged. It gives the same verdict on the real tree (green at 18, and green at `19.0.0-next.0` in the roll control). Only the pass line changes: it now lists 1 dormant entry instead of 2.

## Evidence (head `afc4d58e`)

- `node scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs --self-test` → `✓ check-future-spec-major self-test: 34 cases pass.` (base: 33).
- `node scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` → exit 0, `3 live witnessed ledger entr(y|ies)`, `1 DORMANT ledger entr(y|ies) … docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md (major 18)`.
- **Deletion rehearsal.** With `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md` moved out of the tree, the gate exits 0 (21148 scanned files instead of 21149). The file was then restored and checked byte-identical with `git hash-object`. PR 2's deletion therefore needs no further edit to this script.
- Derived gate families: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` gives 33. All 33 ran locally at exit 0, including `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 1917 cases). `--ran` reconciliation: `33 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- No `*.test.*` file names this script. Its `--self-test` is its suite.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` is the only file changed, so this PR is in-repo tooling with no published surface and carries `skip-changeset`.
- The remaining dormant entry (ADR-0087, major 18) is also due for deletion by the gate's own rule. It is not touched here because it has nothing to do with the sweep ledger. Successor: none.
